open_gaps.gap: A headless Svelte 5 rival is outgrowing us on our own positioning
open_gaps.why: @svgrid/grid (first published 2026-06-16) is headless-first like us, ships virtualization + Excel-style filtering + tree data + pivot, and lists svelte-headless-table / svelte-headless-table-alternative among its npm keywords. v3.0.3 (2026-09-11) adds a hosted MCP server and a migration codemod that handles createColumnHelper columns - it now recruits from TanStack's user base as well as ours. v4.0.0 (2026-09-18, no release notes) adds an Excel spreadsheet mode (formula engine, workbook, SvSheet ribbon) and a Gantt view in @svgrid/enterprise - drifting toward ag-grid/spreadsheet territory (our non-goal), which sharpens our focused-headless argument. 2026-09-25: 4.0.0 was UNPUBLISHED; latest back to 3.0.5 (09-19); spreadsheet/formula work continues on main.
open_gaps.worth_doing: yes - promote to competitors and add a vs-svgrid compare page. 7th run pending a maintainer decision; 4,043/wk vs our 1,596 on 2026-09-25 (both in a registry-wide dip).

open_gaps.why: TanStack v9 advertises up to 90% memory savings and 40-70% faster row models; @svgrid/grid claims 2x-2.5x. We publish nothing and our own consUs admits it.
